commands.docker_config: cd Nodes/Python && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml config
commands.docker_status: cd Nodes/Python && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm --no-deps pybitnode python -m pybitnode.healthcheck
commands.docker_supervisor: cd Nodes/Python && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d pybitnode-supervisor
commands.docker_supervisor_status: cd Nodes/Python && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm --no-deps pybitnode-supervisor-status
commands.docker_supervisor_stop: cd Nodes/Python && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm --no-deps pybitnode-supervisor-stop
commands.docker_supervisor_resume: cd Nodes/Python && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm --no-deps pybitnode-supervisor-resume
commands.docker_smoke_once: cd Nodes/Python && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm --no-deps pybitnode-rocksdb-proof
